prompt: Implement a combinational 1-bit AND gate. The output y should be high only when both inputs are high.
module_signature: module top_module(input a, input b, output y);
testbench: module tb; reg a; reg b; wire y; top_module dut(.a(a), .b(b), .y(y)); initial begin a=0; b=0; #1; if (y !== 0) $fatal; a=0; b=1; #1; if (y !== 0) $fatal; a=1; b=0; #1; if (y !== 0) $fatal; a=1; b=1; #1; if (y !== 1) $fatal; $finish; end endmodule
